description: Handwritten independent synthetic D24 retrieval corpus with bilingual and cross-language query/source pairs plus related distractors; labels frozen before model scoring, separate from D23 reconstruction.

documents.text: The database backup runs at 02:00 UTC every night. Restore requires verifying the archive checksum before loading data.
Xóa file sẽ ẩn nguồn ngay trong PostgreSQL. Việc dọn blob và trả quota phải chờ các reader đang giữ khóa đóng lại.
Tesseract currently recognizes English. Blurred text may be unreadable; low confidence requires human review rather than automatic acceptance.
Spreadsheet formulas and cached values are preserved without recalculation. Editing a literal input can leave an old cached formula result stale.
Mỗi storage root có namespace UUID bền vững. Journal chỉ cho phép đọc file trong namespace khớp với root; không tự nhận blob lạ.
API chỉ phục vụ localhost với bearer token của principal. Yêu cầu không xác thực bị từ chối401, principal khác không nhìn thấy file và nhận404.
Embedding retrieval uses query and passage prefixes, attention-mask mean pooling, L2 normalization and cosine distance. It does not generate answers.
Giới hạn UTF-8 bytes không phải số token. Trước khi embedding phải đếm bằng tokenizer thật và từ chối input quá dài, không cắt âm thầm.
Local VLM transcription is explicitly requested. Its table output is unverified, confidence is null and human review is always required.
A paired restore must recover the database, blob hashes, storage namespace and authenticated principal bindings together. Database rows alone are insufficient.
Một hàng bảng được giữ nguyên trong một chunk. Nếu structured row vượt byte cap thì trả413; không bỏ bớt cell hoặc cắt hàng.
Nested DOCX tables create overlapping paragraph membership and are rejected with422. Flat tables retain row, column and merged-cell provenance.
Shutdown cancels and joins active operations before closing the storage root and database pool. Nested contexts keep a reference count until all resources close.
One shared Qdrant instance hosts versioned collections. Different embedding dimensions require different vector schemas; tenant filters are server-derived.
Health checks report service readiness. A running container alone does not demonstrate application quality, retrieval accuracy or successful restore.
Source spans use Unicode code-point offsets, not UTF-8 byte offsets. Combining marks and non-BMP characters must remain unchanged without normalization.
Memory extraction is opt-in. Users must be able to inspect, edit, disable and delete stored preferences with provenance and retention rules.
HTTP responses containing private documents use Cache-Control private, no-store and nosniff. This does not imply persistent extraction caching.
Hóa đơn thử nghiệm có tổng tiền42 USD và mã2048. Đây là fixture tổng hợp dùng đo OCR, không phải dữ liệu thanh toán của người dùng.
A failed vector cleanup is retried through a durable tombstone/outbox. Source authorization hides deleted files even while stale vector points remain.
